title: Verify reviewer SMTP recipient envelope acceptance without DATA or mail send
acceptance: owner-only command is bound to release issue 3072 and registration matrix 3785
unique reviewer email is resolved only inside REG.RU through auth.staff_reviewer_password_reset_subject() under pc_staff_runtime
reviewer email never reaches Actions stdout, issue comments, artifacts, command arguments or repository files
exactly one active API and Web container from the same Docker Compose project are required and their OCI revisions must match each other
SMTP probe runs inside the active Web container using its existing PC_SMTP_* environment
probe performs TLS greeting, EHLO transparent-price.local, AUTH PLAIN, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO reviewer, RSET and QUIT
probe must never issue DATA and therefore cannot send a message
only bounded result/stage/latency classes are published; raw SMTP replies and reviewer identity remain private
no password reset, database write, identity/password/MFA/session/runtime/deployment/container mutation occurs
exact main is checked before and after the production read
